parentApp.body: Print this poster for your front desk. Parents scan the code, sign in to the Family Hub and ask to connect with {academy}. They only see their children after a code sent to the email you have for them, or after you approve their request.

parentApp.requests: Parents who ask without a match appear in Join requests.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: {academy}
privacy.settingsBody: Generated from AcademyBee's template with your academy's name and contact details. Parents see it before they agree to how you use their child's details. Every consent records the version.
privacy.draft: Draft wording until legal review is complete.
privacy.contactMissing: Add your academy's email and phone in Settings → Academy so parents know whom to ask.

who.title: Who looks after your data
who.body: {academy} decides how your and your child's details are used (the data fiduciary). AcademyBee runs the software for {academy} and processes the details only on its instructions.

what.title: What we keep
what.body: Your child's name, date of birth, class and progress records, attendance and fees; your name, phone and email; and, only if you agree, photos of your child.

why.title: Why
why.body: To run classes, take attendance, manage fees and keep you informed. Photos and news or offers are separate choices you can say no to.

share.title: Who sees it
share.body: Staff of {academy} who need it for their work. Medical notes are seen only by the owner, admins and your child's teachers. Nothing is sold or shared with other academies.

keep.title: How long
keep.body: While your child learns at {academy}, and afterwards only as long as the law requires (for example, fee records).

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can see and correct your details, withdraw a consent (we explain what changes), and ask for your child's details to be removed. Ask {academy} or use the Family Hub.

joinRequests.title: Join requests
joinRequests.body: Parents who asked to connect with {academy} from the Family Hub. Approve by choosing their child, or reject.
joinRequests.emptyBody: When parents scan your poster and you don't have their email yet, their request shows here.
joinRequests.studentsHint: Search and choose one or more students.
joinRequests.approved: {name} linked. They'll confirm in the Family Hub.
joinRequests.rejectBody: They'll see that the academy couldn't confirm the request.
